testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer an available command after changing the target: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1222:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer an available command after changing the target ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and the Part 3D Model target ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel list is initially empty ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list ✔ And the user opens the target selector ✔ And the user selects the Part Tools target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains selected in the available command list ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part Tools custom panel list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
